Five things to do first, with AI as your support.
Remember, this is what I learned from AI, not financial advice.
Your job is to learn with AI. One: check your HMRC balance.
Two: gather the company's books and records. Three: get a licensed insolvency practitioner.
I chose one with 4.8 stars on Trustpilot.
Four: stop trading, and don't pay one creditor ahead of the others. Your practitioner will confirm this.
Five: close your invoices and bring every bank account to zero, or the money goes to the Crown.
Connect all of these parts to AI so you can iterate.
Be ready to learn the details and act on the fly.
